# Static front-end fixture

`index.html` is the smallest page that the web server tests (`app-shell`, `security-headers`, `change-password` and
the access matrix) use as the folder of the built front end, so they run without building the real one.

## Provenance (RNF-009)

The file was written by hand for this repository by the Rosetta contributors and is covered by the repository's MIT
licence. It holds one sentence of plain text and is not a copy of any other page.

Nothing here comes from the owner's employer (DEC-03).
